notes.title: Invitations for the second round of testing of Shadow Heroes
notes.notes:
The STEAM game 'Shadow Hero' will start the second round of experience test on September 17, 2022. [Steam store transmission]: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2089920/Shadow_Heroes/
The test aims to collect players' experience feedback. Although we have repeatedly polished every detail, there are still many shortcomings. I hope you can actively give us your valuable suggestions.
[Game introduction] Shadow hero is an act game with roguelike elements.
Different roles, different characteristics
The game contains six characters with different styles, each of which has its own distinctive characteristics and different attack methods.

Rich equipment
Each character has up to 6 pieces of equipment. Collect powerful equipment to strengthen and further improve their strength.

Random elements
The game is full of random elements, random events and random treasure boxes, so that you can have a different experience every time.

[Recruitment time] September 15~18, 2022
[Participation method] Email to 1214460803@qq.com Apply for test qualification
[Test time] September 17~18, 2022
[Precautions]:
1. If you have suggestions or encounter bugs, welcome to join the group for feedback;
2. The game will be recycled when the test time is over.
If you like this game, please add a wish list to support us.
